title: Los Angeles Tacos Cruise Bike Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
We have a limited number of small and kids bikes.
Children over 8, with street bike riding experience are welcome.
policies: Must know how to ride a bike in a straight line for up to 20 minutes at a time.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Los Angeles is known for its incredible foodie scene. Tacos are a local staple of Angeleno's diets. You can find tacos everywhere, but if you want to find the secret, locals only stand out tacos, come ride with us. Starting out at LA's historic food hall, Grand Central Market, with so many choices you'll want a guide to show you the best stalls to visit. We've curated the rest of our taco cruise to highlight a variety of the best tacos downtown LA has to offer; from Michelin starred chefs, to street stand, off the beaten path taqueros, we'll try as many as we can before you're full. Riding bikes while chasing tacos enables us to bypass the traffic, and seek out the hidden local treasures and pathways only accessible by bike.
